title: Total DNA Extraction from Microalgae Using NucleoSpin Plant Kit
author: Sarah Romac
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b2ctqawn
materials: After centrifugation, store the DNA at -20°C.

steps.title: Prepare Microalgae Pellet
steps.instruction: Isolate the microalgae strain to prepare the pellet for extraction.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 2mL of the strain into a sterile 2mL microtube.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 5000g to pellet the strain.
Discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Initial Lysis and Protein Digestion
steps.instruction: Add lysis and digestion reagents to the pellet.

substeps.instruction: Add 400µL PL1 and 25µL proteinase K (20 mg/mL).
Vortex the mixture.

steps.title: Optional Prokaryotic DNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform this step only if prokaryotic DNA (microbiome) extraction is required.

substeps.instruction: Add 100µl Lysozyme (20mg/mL).
Vortex and incubate for 5 min at room-temperature.

steps.title: Incubate Lysate
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample in a thermomixer for 60 min at 55°C and 900 rpm.

steps.title: Filter Lysate
steps.instruction: Clarify the lysate using a NucleoSpin Filter column.

substeps.instruction: Short spin the lysate.
Transfer the lysate onto a NucleoSpin Filter column (purple column).
Centrifuge for 5min at 11 000g.

steps.title: Collect Eluate
steps.instruction: Transfer the filtered lysate to a new tube.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the eluate into a new sterile 2mL microtube.
If a pellet is visible, transfer only the supernatant without touching the pellet.

steps.title: Bind DNA to Column
steps.instruction: Bind the DNA to the green NucleoSpin column using PC buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 550 µL PC buffer and mix by pipetting up and down at least 5 times.
Transfer all liquid onto a green column (max 650µL).
Centrifuge for 1min at 11 000g and discard the flow-through.
Repeat the transfer and centrifugation process until all liquid has been loaded on the green column.

steps.title: Wash DNA with PW1
steps.instruction: Perform the first wash of the membrane.

substeps.instruction: Add 400µL PW1 to the membrane of the column.
Centrifuge for 1min at 11 000g and discard the flow-through.

steps.title: Wash DNA with PW2
steps.instruction: Perform sequential washes of the membrane with PW2 buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 700µL PW2 to the membrane of the column.
Centrifuge for 1min at 11 000g and discard the flow-through.
Add 200µL PW2 to the membrane of the column.
Centrifuge for 2min at 11 000g and discard the flow-through.

steps.title: Prepare for Elution
steps.instruction: Place the column into a labeled collection tube.

substeps.instruction: Put the column on a new sterile 1.5mL microtube correctly labeled with name, date, and operator.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA using preheated PE buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 50µL PE (preheated to 65°C) onto the membrane.
Incubate for 5 min at 65°C.
Centrifuge for 1min at 11 000g.
Add another 50µL PE (preheated to 65°C) onto the membrane.
Centrifuge for 1min at 11 000g.
